rescale_actions_tensor: rescale a torch tensor of actions from one range to another using linear interpolation
whiten_normalize_tensor: whiten a torch tensor by subtracting the mean and dividing by standard deviation
compute_discounted_returns: compute discounted reward-to-go returns from a sequence of rewards with a given gamma
generate_action_permutations: generate all permutations of actions for a given sequence length and action set size
review_utils_functions: review the training utility functions for action rescaling, whitening, discounted returns, and permutations
